questions.stem: 460 people visited a zoo on Saturday and 355 people visited the zoo on Sunday. If total number of men who visited the zoo on these two days is 315, then find the fraction of people who visited the zoo in these two days are not men.
questions.solution: ![Total number of people visited the zoo on Saturday and Sunday = 460 + 355 = 815 Number of men visited the zoo on both the days = 315 So, number of people who are not men and visited the zoo on both the days = 815 – 315 = 500 ∴ Required fraction = 500 = 100 815 163](asset:q22-sol)

questions.stem: Rohit packed 4375 cookies into packets of 5. He sold them at ₹ 13 per packet. How much total amount did he get?
questions.solution:
Total number of cookies = 4375

Number of cookies in 1 packet = 5

So, number of packets formed = 4375 ÷ 5 = 875 Now, cost of each packet = ₹ 13

So, total amount he gets = ₹ (13 × 875 ) = ₹ 11375

questions.stem: ![Sakshi used a rope to form the given rectangle. If the length of rectangle is thrice its breadth, then find the total length of rope used by her. A. 90 cm B. 150 cm C. 120 cm D. 60 cm](asset:q24-full)
questions.solution:
Breadth of rectangle = 15 cm

So, length of rectangle = 3 × 15 = 45 cm

∴ Total length of rope used = 2 (length + breadth) = 2 (15 + 45)

= 120 cm

questions.stem: A restaurant can accommodate 5200 guests. If there are 1205 adults and 1820 children in the restaurant, then how many more guests can be accommodated in the restaurant?
questions.solution:
Number of guests that can be accommodated in the restaurant = 5200

Number of guests that are in the restaurant = 1205 + 1820 = 3025 So, number of more guests that can be accommodated in the restaurant = 5200 – 3025 = 2175

questions.stem: Mr. Sharma put 4 kg 150 g apples, 5 kg 830 g oranges and 3 kg 70 g mangoes in an empty fruit basket. If the total weight of fruits and empty basket is 14 kg 400 g, then find the weight of empty basket.
questions.solution:
Total weight of empty basket and fruit = 14 kg 400 g Total weight of fruits = 4 kg 150 g + 5 kg 830 g + 3 kg 70 g = 4150 g + 5830 g + 3070 g = 13050 g = 13 kg 50 g

So, weight of empty basket = 14 kg 400 g – 13 kg 50 g

= 1 kg 350 g

questions.stem:
Sonali, Sneha and Mahira get ₹ 2500, ₹ 1900 and ₹ 2050 respectively from their parents for the party. They bought the following items for the party.

![figure](asset:q31-stem-fig)

Who among the following was left with the least amount?
questions.solution:
• Amount of money Sonali has = ₹ 2500

Amount of money she spent = ₹ (350 + 410 + 780) = ₹1540 So, amount of money left with her = ₹ (2500 – 1540) = ₹ 960

• Amount of money Sneha has = ₹1900

Amount of money she spent = ₹(485 + 305 + 290) = ₹1080 So, amount of money left with her = ₹(1900 – 1080) = ₹ 820

• Amount of money Mahira has = ₹ 2050

Amount of money she spent = ₹ (550 + 380 + 650) = ₹1580 So, amount of money left with her = ₹ (2050 – 1580) = ₹ 470 Now, ₹ 960 \> ₹ 820 \> ₹ 470

So, Mahira left with the least amount.
